effect: The completed model brings protection, supply and control together, while showing that its cells still need energy and replacement materials.
reaction: The final connection is satisfying, and the reminder about ongoing upkeep gives the model a sense of being alive.

mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the skin layers was most worthwhile because it brought the protective surface and supporting tissue together with distinct roles.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the arm to its supply network was necessary, but it felt predictable as the only offered combination.

surprise.text: The outermost skin cells are no longer living, yet living cells deeper down continually replace them.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the offered combinations had clear purposes in building or connecting the model.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the skin's replacement process and the way supply and control work together made me curious about how the body maintains itself.
